accounting.rationale: The paragraph defines the TARGET-statement route to the existing8.5.18 attribute for the listed objects. It is not an assignment, allocation, association operation, lifetime extension or new local S effect.
8.5.1 permits an attribute specification statement. The actual R862/R863 occurrence is separate from a TARGET attr-spec in a type declaration.
TARGET eligibility retains C865/C866, not POINTER or allocation. Specifying TARGET does not define a payload or establish a pointer's association.

Each target-decl names a data object; variable eligibility, one explicit attribute route, type/rank/corank and scope must hold independently. R863 can itself supply array/coarray specifications rather than only naming a previously shaped array.

8.5.18 retains target eligibility and nonpointer-subobject propagation. Pointer assignment/allocation, actual/dummy association, presence, allocation status, host/target lifetime and undefined-pointer rules retain their canonical owners. No runtime, address, descriptor or ABI promise follows from the statement.

The original TARGET :: A(1000,1000),B illustrates a list whose first object has an inline rank-two array-spec. It is an incomplete example, not a native run or requirement to allocate a million-element test.
The example selects the optional :: form; the production separately permits its omission.
The array-spec belongs to target-decl and supplies dimensions. This is not the name-only CONTIGUOUS grammar or an executable array reference.
B illustrates omission of both declarator groups. Its actual type/rank/eligibility still requires a complete source context; no default data value is supplied.
Complete future controls must supply declarations and avoid repeated shape/TARGET attributes. The fragment gives no pointer association, payload, storage-layout, C or coarray execution evidence.

requirements.title: A TARGET statement has optional colons and a required target-declaration list
requirements.source: 8.6.15 R862, J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF140, printed126.
requirements.definition: TARGET is followed by an optional double colon and a nonempty target-decl list. R401 supplies list expansion and R863 supplies the mandatory object name plus independently optional array/coarray declarator groups. There is no listless all-objects TARGET form. The statement specifies the canonical TARGET attribute, subject to each entity's eligibility and scope.

pending.double-colon-form: PENDING compile/positive-control admission in a complete ordinary module or program: INTEGER :: item followed by TARGET :: item, with no TARGET in the type declaration. The variable is nonpointer, nonconstant and uninitialized. No pointer assignment, association inquiry, payload, allocation, link or runtime is needed for grammar admission.
pending.no-double-colon-form: PENDING the same complete ordinary-variable context using TARGET item with normal token separation. Omission of both colons is permitted; it does not admit one colon or omission of the list. Keep type, entity identity and the sole explicit TARGET route fixed.
pending.multiple-target-declarations: PENDING a complete module with INTEGER :: scalar, values, then TARGET :: scalar, values(3). The first item omits declarators and the second supplies its sole array specification. Every member independently satisfies C865/C866/C815 and R863; changing one item's category cannot masquerade as list evidence. A qualified coarray combination remains a separate R863 source/mode gate.
pending.missing-target-list: PENDING both complete listless forms, TARGET and TARGET ::, in otherwise valid ordinary-variable units. Insert only the already declared item with required separation for each control. Each future report must identify the forbidden form in its fixed source/control context and legitimate staged origin, rather than match a preferred English phrase or generic EOF/missing-END/unsupported output.
pending.list-separator-repair: PENDING a complete context with two distinct nonpointer variables and a missing comma, repaired only by inserting it; separately a trailing-comma contrast is repaired only by deleting that comma. R401 retains the nonempty list owner. Keep all names/declarations and one explicit TARGET per entity fixed; repeated attributes and incompatible array/coshape specifications are not this list predicate.
pending.variable-and-single-route-source: PENDING source-qualified C865/C866/C854/C815 relations for the statement route. A named constant, ordinary procedure or POINTER entity is not made an eligible TARGET variable by appearing in R863; an array specification is not an escape from those restrictions. Type-declaration TARGET followed by another statement is an explicit-attribute overlap, not a local duplicate syntax test. No old canonical type-declaration case is cloned or retagged.
pending.scope-state-and-canonical-source: PENDING complete source/role relationships under14.2.2p9,19.5.1.4p2 and11.1.4p2. USE-associated re-attribution is restricted; an object-name in a local TARGET statement establishes a local identifier against a nongeneric host homonym, unlike borrowing CONTIGUOUS's different name route. Supply independent local type/category declarations. BLOCK specifications create construct entities. Canonical8.5.18,9.7.1.4,10.2.2 and15.5.2/19.5.2 keep target, pointer, dummy, presence and lifetime semantics; no no-op run or unadjudicated numbered-wrapper link is evidence.

requirements.oracle: Complete statement-form admissions and minimally repaired nonempty-list/separator contrasts, using independently eligible variables and actual R863 declarators. Exact source/name/role mappings precede any future canonical reuse or diagnostic predicate.
requirements.oracle_limitation: Numbered reporting capability does not mandate fatal exit, printed R862 or standardized English. A condition-bound complete diagnostic can qualify only with its true input, mode, phase, control and live-origin evidence; source echoes, unrelated context, unsupported facilities or native/internal/resource failures do not. Declaration admission does not establish allocation, pointer association, defined data, persistent target lifetime or physical storage layout. No source/case/link/inventory approval follows from classification.

requirements.title: A target declaration can specify array shape and coarray coshape after an object name
requirements.definition: A target-decl has a required object-name, optionally followed by a parenthesized array-spec and then independently by a bracketed coarray-spec. Either or both groups can be absent; when both appear the array group comes first. Explicit R804/C810 governs the data-object name. R814 and R809 supply the actual array/coarray alternatives with their separate category, rank, corank, bound and state restrictions. This production is not CONTIGUOUS's name-only list.

pending.bare-scalar-name: PENDING a complete INTEGER item declaration and TARGET :: item without either optional group. An already declared array may also be named without repeating its shape. This proves neither POINTER status nor association with any target; it is a compile positive control.
pending.array-category-source: PENDING bounded source/admission relations to every applicable R814 family: constant and qualified nonconstant explicit shape/bounds, genuine nonpointer/nonallocatable assumed-shape dummies, ALLOCATABLE deferred shape, assumed-size dummies and genuine assumed-rank dummies. Complete explicit interfaces and declaration/category rules precede any fixture. POINTER is excluded by C866, and implied-shape named constants required by C838 are excluded by C865; accepting array-spec syntax does not make those TARGET controls valid. C835/C837/C839 and no-CODIMENSION/VALUE assumed-rank conditions remain canonical. Use no undefined bounds/payload inquiry and no optional unsupported-feature skip.
pending.inline-explicit-coarray-spec: PENDING a complete module with INTEGER :: item and TARGET :: item[*], using R809/R811 and C823/C826/C828. Module implicit SAVE satisfies the nonallocatable coarray scope premise; no ordinary automatic local coarray is invented. Qualify the actual coarray-capable compiler mode/profile before interpreting compile results. No image launch, remote access, C pointer, synchronization or cobound/runtime oracle is supplied.
pending.array-and-coarray-groups: PENDING a complete module with separately typed INTEGER data and TARGET :: data(2)[*]. Rank and corank are each one and obey C822; neither attribute is also specified elsewhere. Compare the independently optional scalar, array-only, coarray-only and combined forms through complete controls rather than deleting semantics or assuming the groups are interchangeable. A future reversed-group contrast must preserve all bounds/categories and have a precisely source-qualified order repair.
pending.deferred-coarray-source: PENDING an ordinary complete module declaring INTEGER,ALLOCATABLE :: data, then TARGET :: data(:)[:], with no competing shape/codimension specification. C834 and C827 require the deferred array/coshape groups; C826's ALLOCATABLE route is satisfied. The object need not be allocated for this compile admission and must not be queried or dereferenced. Allocation/image/team/lifetime effects remain9.7/Clause11/19 owners, not a local TARGET runtime effect.
pending.declarator-delimiters-and-order: PENDING complete constant-shape and qualified explicit-coshape sources with one missing closing parenthesis or bracket, repaired solely at that delimiter while retaining the existing object name and type. R863 requires balanced groups and the written array-before-coarray order; it does not allow an empty object name. Any wrong-order repair must be independently checked for C815/C834/C827/C828 confounds and real parser origin, without line coalescing or a blanket EOF predicate.
pending.whole-name-not-designator: PENDING exact R804/C810/R603 source relations. The object-name cannot be a component reference or arbitrary expression, but a suffix such as item(2) in TARGET can be an array declaration, not an array-element designator, so it is not automatically a negative. Complete component-specific sources need a role-valid whole-object repair before any diagnostic is claimed. Do not clone the CONTIGUOUS p(:) exclusion, use a named constant as a control, or infer TARGET statements from assignments to a variable/function named target.
pending.attribute-shape-and-lifetime-source: PENDING canonical8.5.18/8.5.8/8.5.6 and scope relationships, not new execution. Distinguish a new inline shape/coshape from repeating an existing explicit attribute; nonconstant bounds and actual declaration order retain their source rules. TARGET+ALLOCATABLE is not TARGET+POINTER. TARGET subobject propagation, pointer-created targets, optional presence, ordinary TARGET dummy association and processor-dependent persistence keep9.7.1.4,10.2.2,15.5.2.4/.5/.13 and19.5.2 ownership. TARGET does not add SAVE; saved pointers do not extend an unsaved target's lifetime or an internal procedure's ended host instance. No undefined post-return ASSOCIATED/value query, copying/address/ABI promise or automatic canonical reuse is permitted.

requirements.oracle:
Classify the actual required name and independently optional declaration groups before choosing complete finite controls. Keep array/coarray syntax, eligible variable categories, declaration order, scope and compiler capability separate. Future source/interface/reuse plans must bind exact full programs and roles; no generic declaration classifier or no-op runtime stands in for these relationships.

Batch320 R863 attribute-statement fixtures: one inline array-shape control declares rank-one and rank-two TARGET objects through R863 and checks direct RANK/SIZE/LBOUND/UBOUND and payload properties. Its feature mutant changes the inline shape while preserving a conforming program, so the shape assertion fails.
requirements.oracle_limitation:
R863 supplies neither initialization nor POINTER or ALLOCATABLE by itself. A permitted array-spec form is not valid for every entity category, and a coarray-spec requires its actual constraints and configured support. Declaration-level success cannot prove association, payload, target lifetime, image execution or storage representation. Existing TARGET/SAVE/COMMON, bound, pointer and argument owners remain unchanged; every new finite evidence plan is pending until independently implemented and adjudicated.

Batch320 R863 limits: only small constant explicit array shapes are covered. Coarray declarator groups, deferred coarrays, delimiter/order diagnostics, designator exclusions, and canonical lifetime/source links remain pending. Frozen LFortran mishandles the conforming inline TARGET array declaration on this host.

review_rationale: Batch320 bound reference-validated attribute-statement fixtures after two review rounds; seven frozen-LFortran failures (valid rank-2 POINTER, PROTECTED, inline TARGET array and VALUE statements rejected; C893 and two VOLATILE violations accepted) were independently confirmed as genuine.
